document.title: Celebrities and national history
document.question:
Many young people today know more about international celebrities than about the history of their own country. Some see this as a natural result of modern media, while others believe it is a serious loss for society.

Why is this the case? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
